mechanics.claim: Lay Waste deals doubled damage when it hits only a single target, and applies as spell damage in that case versus area damage when it hits multiple targets.
mechanics.quote: dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies within, {{ccs|doubled|magic}} when only one target is struck.

mechanics.claim: The blast is delayed after cast before detonating, so damage does not land immediately on cast.
mechanics.quote: conjures a blast at the target location that detonates after {{tt|{{rutngt|0.5}}{{minus}}{{rutngt|0.75}}|See notes}}
